dataset: Apache SpamAssassin emails + auxiliary UCI SMS Spam Collection

archives.label: per-row ham/spam
archives.citation: Almeida, T. & Hidalgo, J. (2011). SMS Spam Collection. UCI. DOI: 10.24432/C5CC84

deduplication: SHA-256 of normalized body; remove conflicting-label bodies, keep one copy otherwise; near-duplicates may remain
split: stratified by source and label, 70/15/15; vocabulary and IDF fitted on training only
algorithm: L2-regularized logistic regression; balanced class weights; C=4; liblinear
features: TF-IDF word unigrams/bigrams; sublinear term frequency; L2 normalization; max 60000; min_df=2; max_df=0.98

policy.selection: Predeclared conservative review policy, not tuned on test data; app applies thresholds after integer rounding and security checks

evaluation_scope: Text model only; supplemental security rules are not included in these metrics. Final saved model is the evaluated training-split model, without refitting on validation/test.
limitations: Historical English-heavy email and auxiliary SMS data; not a modern phishing benchmark.
SMS supports short-text classification but introduces domain differences from email.
Random holdout is not temporal or thread-separated; near-duplicates and thread overlap can inflate performance.
Probability estimates are not independently calibrated; conservative review can flag legitimate messages.
No sender authentication, link browsing, attachment inspection, or safety guarantee.
